provenance: claude-fable-5-1 via Claude Code, tags prompt v1, 2026-11-05

axes.name: Jace and planeswalker loyalty
axes.definition: Empowering Jace, casting a planeswalker, or otherwise putting loyalty counters on a planeswalker you control, so that you control a planeswalker and can activate loyalty abilities.

axes.name: Scry and surveil triggers
axes.definition: Any card that scries or surveils for you (including the Jace token's [-1], surveil riders on spells, and Peer Review copies), so that 'whenever you scry or surveil' and 'if you've scried or surveilled this turn' cards fire.

axes.name: Noncreature spells and prowess
axes.definition: Casting noncreature spells: instants, sorceries, copies of prepared creatures' spell faces, flashback casts, enchantments and artifacts, which feed prowess, Thopter and Treasure makers and once-per-turn spell triggers.

axes.name: Noncombat damage to opponents
axes.definition: Dealing noncombat damage to an opponent: pingers like Vicious Verse, burn that can target players, attack-trigger pings, discard and landfall pings, and effects that add to such damage.

axes.name: Self-mill and graveyard count
axes.definition: Putting cards into your own graveyard (mill, surveil, discard, looting, sacrificing lands or permanents) to reach threshold, grow graveyard-counting creatures, and give flashback, exile-from-graveyard and reanimation effects targets.

axes.name: Sacrifice and death triggers
axes.definition: Sacrifice outlets and cheap creatures or tokens willing to die, so that 'whenever a creature you control dies', 'if N creatures died this turn' and return-from-graveyard creatures pay off.

axes.name: Life gain
axes.definition: Any effect that gains you life, however small: lifelink, Seed Suture, drain pings, enter-or-die life triggers, and repeatable gain each turn for 'whenever you gain life' payoffs.

axes.name: +1/+1 counters
axes.definition: Putting +1/+1 counters on your creatures (spells, enter triggers, counter-on-arrival effects) so that creatures with counters gain vigilance, flying or haste, grow further, or equip more cheaply.

axes.name: Creatures entering
axes.definition: Putting creatures onto the battlefield often, especially cheap creatures and token makers, so that 'whenever another creature you control enters', 'creature that entered this turn' and creature-count effects trigger.

axes.name: Creature tokens
axes.definition: Creating creature tokens, above all 2/2 Wizard Soldier Cadets but also Thopters, Beasts, Illusions and Dragons, for cards that pump, untap, spare or count tokens or Wizard tokens.

axes.name: Artifacts and Heartwood
axes.definition: Controlling or creating artifacts: Heartwood and Treasure tokens, Thopters, Equipment, Books and artifact creatures, for artifact-count pumps, tap-two-artifacts and sacrifice-an-artifact abilities, and artifact-spell triggers.

axes.name: Lands entering and land count
axes.definition: Extra land drops and land fetching (basic landcycling, land search, returning land cards from the graveyard, extra land plays) for landfall triggers, basic-land-type triggers and six-or-more-lands checks.

axes.name: Discard outlets
axes.definition: Effects that let you discard your own cards: looting, rummaging, discard-as-cost abilities and cycling, which trigger discard payoffs and let cards that want to be discarded do their job.

axes.name: Legendary permanents
axes.definition: Legendary creatures, enchantments and artifacts in play, in hand or in the graveyard, for cards that cost less with a legend, return or discard legendary cards, or put counters on legendary creatures.
